task_title: Publish completion telemetry before optional survey

plan_review.notes: Reviewer identified a load-bearing incompatibility: immutable bundle idempotency rejects survey-bearing resubmits. Revised design is a two-phase contract: publish immutable completion telemetry immediately; append survey separately by server-side runId-to-issue mapping. The implementation will cover the completion/survey race, duplicate completion and survey, human terminal-vs-transition eligibility, AI normal and error finalization, and corrected survey disclosure.
